findings.detail: Hasso was introduced at SAM25; official notes require a two-handed weapon and describe speed/accuracy/Strength benefits, mutually exclusive with Seigan. A second official notice explicitly describes Hasso under Samurai support job. SMN99/SAM49 access is a manual prerequisite: actual unlocked/leveled SAM, active support job and usable Hasso must be checked by the player; no live access discovered.

Fresh exact cards identify Mpaca22100 Main/Staves, SMN eligible, and Khonsu22218 Sub/Grips, SMN eligible. Retained reviewed registry classifies exact IDs two_handed/grip. This supports a lawful prospective staff/grip context, not recommended gear equivalence or ownership.

findings.detail: Original node380 calls Hasso JA haste and presents /SAM or /WAR alternatives. Its 10% and slower-TP comparison remain attributed guide observations. No verified category caps, combined delay formula, x-hit result, accuracy target or superiority is adopted.

findings.status: confirmed recast caution; casting details source-limited
findings.detail: Official notes impose a magic/song/ninjutsu recast penalty under Hasso. They do not establish a present numeric casting/recast multiplier, a summoning-spell schedule, or Blood Pact timing. FFXIclopedia search extract mentions casting as well; full article reads failed, so the extract is a lead only and no casting multiplier is adopted.

All three fresh grids retain four omissions (main/sub/range/ammo). Guide alternatives do not prove the complete independently authored /WAR staff/grip/ammo fills or DT/Accuracy substitutions equivalent for /SAM. No /SAM-specific rebalancing, buff/recipient schedule or complete haste-tier comparison was established. Preserve /WAR identities and coverage unchanged; do not duplicate or silently widen them.
